info.description: E-commerce backend: catalog, cart, orders, Zibal payments, inventory, CMS, support chat and notifications. All JSON responses are wrapped in {"message": string, "data": any}.
info.title: E-Commerce Server API

post.description: Stores the notification and dispatches it via Telegram when channel is telegram or both. Omit user_id to broadcast.

Creates storekeeper, accountant, marketer or support users. Creating another admin is not allowed. default_avatar_id is a preset frontend avatar index (1..5); avatar_media_id references an uploaded MinIO media asset.

parameters.description: Search in key, title or name
parameters.name: search

post.description: Creates a standalone attribute that can later be assigned to any product. key must be unique.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the attribute and unassigns it from all products

post.description: Staff and customer login with mobile/password. user_type is optional; when omitted staff accounts are checked first.
Converts the cart into a pending order, optionally redeeming a discount code, issues a system pre-invoice and sends invoice/pre-invoice bot messages
Adds the product or increases its quantity if already present

delete.description: Soft-deletes the category; direct children become root categories
The path segment is the blog post ID

patch.description: The path segment is the blog post ID. media_ids, when provided, replaces the attached media.

get.summary: Static site settings and active banners

patch.description: Upserts site content entries by key (H1 titles, footer links, descriptions, logos)

get.description: Available to admin, accountant, marketer and support (read-only)

post.description: Creates a discount code (admin, accountant, marketer). Omit code to auto-generate an 8 character uppercase code. max_price caps the discount and is only allowed for percent type (e.g. 30% up to 50000). When owner_mobile is set only the customer with that mobile can use the code.

get.description: Available to admin, accountant, marketer and support (read-only)

patch.description: Updates a discount (admin, accountant, marketer). Send max_price 0 to remove the cap and owner_mobile "" to make the code public.

post.description: Issues a pre-invoice for an order (amount defaults to the order total) and notifies the customer

get.description: Paid, processing and delivered orders aggregated per period bucket

post.description: Uploads an image, video or document to MinIO and stores its metadata

get.description: Called by the Zibal gateway. Verifies the payment and credits the paid amount to the customer wallet. For orders the order price is then debited from the wallet and order/transaction/pre-invoice are updated. Sends bot messages and redirects (302) to the client app with ?inv=inv-<ORDER-ID> for orders or ?wallet=wlt-<TRACK-ID> for wallet charges

302.description: Redirect to client payment result page

post.description: Requests a Zibal trackId for a pending/failed order and returns the gateway redirect URL. On success the paid amount is credited to the customer wallet and the order price is then debited from it.
post.summary: Start Zibal payment for an order

post.description: Debits the order total from the customer wallet balance and marks the order as paid
Queries Zibal /v1/inquiry for the track ID and returns it with the local transaction record
Requests a Zibal trackId to top up the customer wallet. After a verified payment the wallet is credited automatically and the callback redirects to the client app with ?wallet=wlt-<TRACK-ID>
Product title and SKU must be unique. media_ids attaches uploaded images/videos. attribute_ids assigns existing attributes.

patch.description: media_ids and attribute_ids, when provided, replace the product media set and attribute set

post.description: Adds existing attributes to the product; already assigned attributes are kept

patch.description: default_avatar_id is a preset frontend avatar index (1..5); avatar_media_id references an uploaded MinIO media asset

get.summary: List messages of a chat room

post.summary: Reply to a chat room as support

get.description: Chat history of the current customer including automated bot messages

post.description: REST fallback for sending a message to support; opens a room if none is active
Validates a discount code for the current customer against an amount and returns the discount and payable amount without redeeming it

patch.description: Updates name, mobile, address, coordinates and telegram chat id (customers have no avatar)

get.description: Returns the wallet of the authenticated user or staff member

post.description: Credits or debits a wallet (admin and accountant only). Admin wallets are locked and cannot be modified by anyone, and staff cannot change their own wallet.

get.description: Upgrades to WebSocket. Pass the JWT as ?token= query, Authorization header or access_token cookie. Customers send {"message":"..."}; support agents send {"room_id":1,"message":"..."}. Server pushes ChatMessage JSON frames.

valid.description: Valid is true if Time is not NULL

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and the JWT token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
